$comment: HumanGateway protocol v1.0.0 (2026-08-28). Error model (protocol §7 #3, identity-security §6). Referenced by delivery.schema.json (FAILED state) through common.$defs.error; the same shape is reused for sync/API error responses so every component surfaces identical machine-readable errors.
title: Error
description: The protocol error model. A stable, machine-readable error 'code' plus a human-readable 'message', optional structured 'details', and a retryability hint. The reserved code catalog lives in $defs.errorCode and is stable across releases (codes are added, never changed or removed); components and consumers may extend the catalog using the same UPPER_SNAKE token shape. Error payloads must never carry secrets, registration tokens, session tokens, or password material (SP-07).

code.description: Machine-readable, stable error code. Reserved codes are enumerated in $defs.errorCode; extensions must follow the same UPPER_SNAKE shape.

message.description: Human-readable error description. Safe to display to end users; MUST NOT contain secrets (SP-07).

details.description: Optional machine-readable detail fields (e.g. expected vs received content hash, failed gatewayId, conversationId). MUST NOT contain secrets.

retryable.description: Whether retrying may succeed. True for transient conditions (timeout, rate limit, temporary connectivity); false for permanent rejections (authentication, authorisation, validation, hash mismatch).

errorCode.title: Reserved Error Code
errorCode.description: The reserved protocol error-code catalog. Stable across releases: codes are added, never changed or removed. Used by delivery FAILED records and sync/API error responses.
